study_identification_part.si_4_title: Deep Normative Tractometry for Identifying Joint White Matter Macro- and Micro-structural Abnormalities in Alzheimer's Disease

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study introduces Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT) framework using a convolutional variational autoencoder (ConvVAE) to encode the joint distribution of macrostructural and microstructural profiles of brain white matter tracts. The model has an asymmetric architecture with a 4-layer encoder, 3-layer decoder, latent dimension of 64, and uses depthwise separable convolution. The model contains 454,742 trainable parameters.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: This study introduces the Deep Normative Tractometry (DNT) framework, that encodes the joint distribution of both macrostructural and microstructural profiles of the brain white matter tracts through a variational autoencoder (VAE); Combined with the 3D spatial coordinates, each streamline, of size 128 x 5, was used as input to the ConvVAE model to jointly model both bundle geometry and microstructure.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Feng2024.pdf.md: Abstract / Section III-B (Deep Normative Tractometry)

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) derived from diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) were used as microstructural measures. Additionally, 3D spatial coordinates representing tract geometry (shape) were modeled alongside these measures. Each streamline consisted of 128 equidistant points with 5 features (3D coordinates + FA + MD).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Diffusion tensors were fitted with non-linear least-squares to produce fractional anisotropy (FA) and medial diffusivity (MD) scalar maps in the DWI native space; DTI-derived FA and MD scalars were then mapped to each point on the corresponding native space bundle to create the bundle profile. Combined with the 3D spatial coordinates, each streamline, of size 128 x 5, was used as input to the ConvVAE model.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Feng2024.pdf.md: Section II (DATA) / Section III-B (Deep Normative Tractometry)

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: For the DNT framework, age, sex, and scanner effects were corrected using linear regression on the anomaly scores. The BUAN comparison method used age and sex as fixed effects with subject and scanner as random effects in a linear mixed model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We then corrected for age, sex, and scanner effect using linear regression; For each group comparison (MCI vs. CN and AD vs. CN), we computed group statistics using a linear mixed model (LMM), where diagnosis, age, and sex were modeled as fixed effects, and subject and scanner were modeled as random effects.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Feng2024.pdf.md: Section III-A (BUAN) / Section III-B (Deep Normative Tractometry)
